0022600190.text: Brooklyn (2-6, 13th in the East and 5.5 games back in the Atlantic, on a one-game win streak after a 2-6 stretch) is on the road at Atlanta (5-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, on a two-game win streak) for its 9th game of the season. Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost 0-4 to the Hawks, including a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
